scope: All non-education GeoJSON datasets in the current Geoportal Wajo baseline.
important_boundary_note: The local Wajo mask is derived from the package boundary layer. Current BIG service metadata shows a June 2026 national administrative edition, so local boundary freshness should be refreshed from BIG before asserting current administrative geometry.
